newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.2 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.2 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated at 0.2 percent in the week ended April 14, unchanged from the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of April will be one percent, the committee said. The monthly inflation rate in March was 1.4 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended April 14 April 7
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.3 +0.2
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.037 +0.037
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
